problemSigns.detail: As your garage door moves, worn rollers often create harsh, high-pitched noises. These sounds indicate metal-on-metal friction or failing bearings.
A garage door that shakes or moves unevenly in its track points to rollers that are no longer gliding smoothly. They may be catching or binding.
Inspect your rollers for any flat areas on the wheel or if they appear to wobble significantly as they turn. This is a clear sign of wear.
The metal stem attaching the roller to the hinge can corrode or bend, especially in damp environments. This prevents proper roller function and track alignment.

After installation, we perform a balance test and safety-reverse test. We ensure the door operates smoothly and safely.
